evidence: CQQ removed 30194 source bytes; x86-XZ payload fell 240720 to 234216 bytes; normalized parent and child builds have identical nncp and libnc.so SHA-256 hashes.
hypothesis: Quotienting decoder-irrelevant C/C++ comments and horizontal whitespace, then normalizing debug-free compilation, preserves the exact native T4 NNCP archive while reducing the counted self-contained package by 6,371 bytes.
kill_condition: Retire immediately on archive mismatch, roundtrip failure, nondeterminism, package growth above 236510 bytes, or resource ineligibility.
promotion_condition: At 10K, exact archive bytes equal 6229, roundtrip and second archive are byte-identical, counted package is 236510 bytes, and measured resources remain eligible.
title: NNCP compact5 CQQ x86-XZ normalized T4
